lines.pinyin: Yǐzi yào zuò hěn jiǔ, yídìng yào xiān shìzuò. Wǎnglù shàng kàn bù chūlái zuò qǐlái shūfu bù shūfu.
lines.english: You sit on a chair for a long time, so you have to try sitting on it first. Online you cannot tell whether it is comfortable.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也對，我上次在網路上買的那張，坐不到一個小時就不舒服。
lines.simplified: 也对，我上次在网路上买的那张，坐不到一个小时就不舒服。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì, wǒ shàng cì zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi de nà zhāng, zuò bú dào yí ge xiǎoshí jiù bù shūfu.
lines.english: True. The one I bought online last time was uncomfortable within an hour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 所以我們先在這裡坐坐看，再回去上網比價就行了。
lines.simplified: 所以我们先在这里坐坐看，再回去上网比价就行了。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ wǒmen xiān zài zhèlǐ zuòzuo kàn, zài huíqù shàngwǎng bǐjià jiù xíng le.
lines.english: So we sit on it here first, then go home and compare prices online.

lines.traditional: 小姐，這是今天剛做好的蛋糕，要不要試吃一塊？
lines.simplified: 小姐，这是今天刚做好的蛋糕，要不要试吃一块？

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊。味道不錯，不會太甜。
lines.simplified: 好啊。味道不错，不会太甜。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wèidào búcuò, bú huì tài tián.
lines.english: Sure. It tastes good, not too sweet.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一盒八塊，現在買兩盒有優惠，第二盒打八折。
lines.simplified: 一盒八块，现在买两盒有优惠，第二盒打八折。
lines.pinyin: Yì hé bā kuài, xiànzài mǎi liǎng hé yǒu yōuhuì, dì èr hé dǎ bā zhé.
lines.english: Eight pieces a box. If you buy two boxes now there is a discount: twenty percent off the second.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我先買一盒回去。家人也喜歡的話，下次再多買幾盒。
lines.simplified: 我先买一盒回去。家人也喜欢的话，下次再多买几盒。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān mǎi yì hé huíqù. Jiārén yě xǐhuān dehuà, xià cì zài duō mǎi jǐ hé.
lines.english: I'll take one box home first. If my family like it too, I'll buy a few more next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼沒有趁優惠買兩盒？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没有趁优惠买两盒？

prompt.english: Why does the woman not buy two boxes while there is a discount?

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: She wants to find out first whether her family like it.

questions.why: She buys one box first and will buy more next time 家人也喜歡的話: the family decides. She says the cake is 不會太甜, and the second box is 20% off. Eight pieces a box is the seller's fact, not her reason.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你要出去啊？
lines.simplified: 你要出去啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yào chūqù a?
lines.english: Are you going out?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，我要去樓下的超商領錢。
lines.simplified: 对，我要去楼下的超商领钱。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yào qù lóuxià de chāoshāng lǐng qián.
lines.english: Yes, I'm going to the convenience store downstairs to take out money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你順便幫我把這箱舊書寄給我妹妹，好不好？地址我寫好了。
lines.simplified: 那你顺便帮我把这箱旧书寄给我妹妹，好不好？地址我写好了。

lines.english: Then could you send this box of old books to my sister for me while you are there? I have written the address.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好。這箱太重，我開車去郵局寄。
lines.simplified: 好。这箱太重，我开车去邮局寄。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Zhè xiāng tài zhòng, wǒ kāichē qù yóujú jì.
lines.english: Sure. This box is too heavy; I'll drive to the post office and send it.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的出门以后会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de chūmén yǐhòu huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the man do when he goes out?

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Only take out money and not send her books.

choices.pinyin: Lǐng wán qián, zài chāoshāng bǎ shū jì chūqù.
choices.english: Take out money, then send the books from the store.

choices.simplified: 领钱，再开车去邮局寄书
choices.pinyin: Lǐng qián, zài kāichē qù yóujú jì shū.
choices.english: Take out money, then drive to the post office to send the books.

choices.simplified: 开车去邮局寄给自己的妹妹
choices.pinyin: Kāichē qù yóujú jì gěi zìjǐ de mèimei.
choices.english: Drive to the post office and send them to his own sister.

questions.why: He is going to the store to take out money, and she asks him to send her books 順便 while there; but he answers that the box is too heavy and he will drive to the post office to send it. So he does both jobs, and the books go from the post office, not the store. He says 好, so he does send them, and they go to her sister, not his.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我最喜歡的明星設計的球鞋，只賣三天，我一定要買到。
lines.simplified: 我最喜欢的明星设计的球鞋，只卖三天，我一定要买到。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de míngxīng shèjì de qiúxié, zhǐ mài sān tiān, wǒ yídìng yào mǎidào.
lines.english: My favourite star has designed some sneakers. They are only on sale for three days, and I must get a pair.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說一雙要一萬多塊，而且要排好幾個小時。
lines.simplified: 听说一双要一万多块，而且要排好几个小时。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō yì shuāng yào yíwàn duō kuài, érqiě yào pái hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: I hear a pair costs over ten thousand, and you have to queue for hours.

lines.speaker: M

lines.simplified: 就算要排一整夜，我也要排。
lines.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yào pái yì zhěng yè, wǒ yě yào pái.
lines.english: Even if I have to queue all night, I'll queue.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上個月才說要節省一點，真受不了你。

choices.english: He will queue only a few hours.

lines.simplified: 我想去那家皮鞋店，把上次买的鞋子拿去换。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù nà jiā píxié diàn, bǎ shàng cì mǎi de xiézi ná qù huàn.
lines.english: I want to go to that shoe shop and change the shoes I bought last time.

lines.simplified: 那家店早就关了。我上个月经过的时候，那里已经是一家咖啡店了。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zǎo jiù guān le. Wǒ shàng ge yuè jīngguò de shíhòu, nàlǐ yǐjīng shì yì jiā kāfēi diàn le.
lines.english: That shop closed long ago. When I passed last month, it was already a café.

prompt.english: Why does the man say "forget it"?

lines.english: Last time the company also bought the cheapest, but they tore after only a few washes, and we had to spend money buying more.

lines.english: Another is a bit dearer, but the quality is good, and tall or short, they make them to the size each person wears.

lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ xiàwǔ jiù dǎ diànhuà gěi nà jiā.
lines.english: Fine, I'll phone that shop this afternoon.

passage.traditional: {1}爸爸說不用送他禮物，今年他生日，我還是想送他一樣有用的東西。我發現他身上那條皮帶已經用了十幾年，旁邊都破了。所以我{2}請假，去{3}選皮帶。那裡的價錢比夜市高，可是品質比較好。我比較了好幾個牌子，最後選了一條咖啡色的。店員非常{4}，知道是要{5}的，就把皮帶包好，還送了一張卡片。爸爸打開外面漂亮的紙，馬上換上新皮帶。那條舊的，他第二天就把它{6}掉了。
passage.simplified: {1}爸爸说不用送他礼物，今年他生日，我还是想送他一样有用的东西。我发现他身上那条皮带已经用了十几年，旁边都破了。所以我{2}请假，去{3}选皮带。那里的价钱比夜市高，可是品质比较好。我比较了好几个牌子，最后选了一条咖啡色的。店员非常{4}，知道是要{5}的，就把皮带包好，还送了一张卡片。爸爸打开外面漂亮的纸，马上换上新皮带。那条旧的，他第二天就把它{6}掉了。

Wǒ fāxiàn tā shēnshàng nà tiáo pídài yǐjīng yòng le shí jǐ nián, pángbiān dōu pò le. Suǒyǐ wǒ tèdì qǐngjià, qù zhuānguì xuǎn pídài. Nàlǐ de jiàqián bǐ yèshì gāo, kěshì pǐnzhí bǐjiào hǎo. Wǒ bǐjiào le hǎo jǐ ge páizi, zuìhòu xuǎn le yì tiáo kāfēisè de. Diànyuán fēicháng tǐtiē, zhīdào shì yào sòng rén de, jiù bǎ pídài bāo hǎo, hái sòng le yì zhāng kǎpiàn. Bàba dǎkāi wàimiàn piàoliang de zhǐ, mǎshàng huàn shàng xīn pídài. Nà tiáo jiù de, tā dì èr tiān jiù bǎ tā rēngdiào le.
passage.english: Even though my father says there is no need to give him presents, this year for his birthday I still wanted to give him something useful. I noticed that the belt he wears had been in use for over ten years, and its edges were worn through. So I specially took time off and went to a department store counter to choose a belt. Prices there are higher than at the night market, but the quality is better. I compared several brands and chose a brown one. The clerk was very thoughtful: knowing it was a present, she wrapped the belt and added a card. My father opened the pretty paper on the outside and put on the new belt straight away. As for the old one, the next day he threw it away.

text.english: Last summer our air conditioner broke. Dad did not buy a new one straight away; first he looked online at the air conditioners different companies make, then went round three shops comparing prices. He said a machine like an air conditioner is used for ten years once you have it, so you have to look not only at the price but also at how much electricity it uses. The clerk at the first shop kept stressing that their model was this year's best seller and also the cheapest. But Dad read the product information carefully and found that it used a great deal of electricity. In the end he bought another company's; it cost three thousand more, but used far less electricity. Mum had thought Dad was making too much fuss, running from shop to shop just to buy an air conditioner. But after one summer with the new one, the electricity bill was almost half of last year's, and now Mum often tells her friends: "Shop around, and you really don't lose out."

text.traditional: 我家附近每個星期六早上都有一個市場，幾十個攤販在那裡賣衣服、鞋子跟生活用品。大部分的攤販都很會推銷，客人一走到面前，就說自己的東西又便宜又好。只有一位賣包包的張太太不一樣。她不僅不會一直推銷，還會告訴客人，哪個包包的口袋容易破，哪個包包比較適合上班用。有人說她這樣做生意一定會吃虧，可是她說：「東西賣出去了，客人用得不開心，以後就不會再來了。」這幾年，張太太的客人一年比一年多，很多人還特地從別的地區來找她。我想，做生意跟做人一樣，實在比什麼都重要。
text.simplified: 我家附近每个星期六早上都有一个市场，几十个摊贩在那里卖衣服、鞋子跟生活用品。大部分的摊贩都很会推销，客人一走到面前，就说自己的东西又便宜又好。只有一位卖包包的张太太不一样。她不仅不会一直推销，还会告诉客人，哪个包包的口袋容易破，哪个包包比较适合上班用。有人说她这样做生意一定会吃亏，可是她说：「东西卖出去了，客人用得不开心，以后就不会再来了。」这几年，张太太的客人一年比一年多，很多人还特地从别的地区来找她。我想，做生意跟做人一样，实在比什么都重要。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng dōu yǒu yí ge shìchǎng, jǐ shí ge tānfàn zài nàlǐ mài yīfu, xiézi gēn shēnghuó yòngpǐn. Dà bùfèn de tānfàn dōu hěn huì tuīxiāo, kèrén yì zǒu dào miànqián, jiù shuō zìjǐ de dōngxi yòu piányí yòu hǎo. Zhǐ yǒu yí wèi mài bāobāo de Zhāng tàitai bù yíyàng. Tā bù jǐn bú huì yìzhí tuīxiāo, hái huì gàosu kèrén, nǎ ge bāobāo de kǒudài róngyì pò, nǎ ge bāobāo bǐjiào shìhé shàngbān yòng. Yǒu rén shuō tā zhèyàng zuò shēngyì yídìng huì chīkuī, kěshì tā shuō: "Dōngxi mài chūqù le, kèrén yòng de bù kāixīn, yǐhòu jiù bú huì zài lái le." Zhè jǐ nián, Zhāng tàitai de kèrén yì nián bǐ yì nián duō, hěn duō rén hái tèdì cóng bié de dìqū lái zhǎo tā. Wǒ xiǎng, zuò shēngyì gēn zuò rén yíyàng, shízài bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
text.english: Every Saturday morning there is a market near my home, where dozens of stallholders sell clothes, shoes and everyday things. Most of them are very good at selling: the moment a customer walks up, they say their goods are cheap and good. Only Mrs. Zhang, who sells bags, is different. Not only does she not keep pushing her goods, she also tells customers which bag has pockets that tear easily and which bag suits going to work. Some people say she is sure to lose out doing business like this, but she says: "If I sell something and the customer is unhappy using it, they won't come back." In the last few years Mrs. Zhang has had more customers every year, and many people even come specially from other areas to find her. I think that in business, as in life, honesty matters more than anything.

text.simplified: 以前我在网路上购物，都请人把东西送到家里。可是我白天要上班，送货的人常常找不到我。后来我改到超商拿，才发现这样做的优点真不少。超商随时都开，我下班经过的时候，就可以顺便把东西拿回家。有一次，我买的上衣大小不合适，店员还教我用超商的服务把衣服寄回去，手续一点也不麻烦。当然，这种方式也有缺点：东西太大、太重的话，就不适合到超商拿，自己提回家挺辛苦的。所以现在除了冰箱、洗衣机这种大东西请人周末送到家里以外，我买的东西都送到超商。

Hòulái wǒ gǎi dào chāoshāng ná, cái fāxiàn zhèyàng zuò de yōudiǎn zhēn bù shǎo. Chāoshāng suíshí dōu kāi, wǒ xiàbān jīngguò de shíhòu, jiù kěyǐ shùnbiàn bǎ dōngxi ná huí jiā. Yǒu yí cì, wǒ mǎi de shàngyī dàxiǎo bù héshì, diànyuán hái jiāo wǒ yòng chāoshāng de fúwù bǎ yīfu jì huíqù, shǒuxù yìdiǎn yě bù máfán. Dāngrán, zhè zhǒng fāngshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn: dōngxi tài dà, tài zhòng dehuà, jiù bú shìhé dào chāoshāng ná, zìjǐ tí huí jiā tǐng xīnkǔ de. Suǒyǐ xiànzài chúle bīngxiāng, xǐyījī zhè zhǒng dà dōngxi qǐng rén zhōumò sòng dào jiā lǐ yǐwài, wǒ mǎi de dōngxi dōu sòng dào chāoshāng.
text.english: I used to have everything I bought online delivered to my home. But I work during the day, and the delivery people often could not find me in. Later I switched to picking things up at a convenience store, and found it has many advantages. The store is open at any hour, so when I pass it after work I can pick my things up on the way home. Once, a top I bought was the wrong size, and the clerk even showed me how to send it back using the store's service; the procedure was no trouble at all. Of course this way has drawbacks too: if something is too big or heavy, collecting it at the store does not suit, as carrying it home yourself is quite hard work. So now, apart from big things like fridges and washing machines, which I have delivered home at the weekend, everything I buy goes to the convenience store.

text.traditional: 我的朋友小美從小就喜歡畫衣服，她的夢想是有一家自己的服裝店。大學畢業以後，她沒有去公司上班，而是在網路上賣自己設計的衣服。她發現個子不高的女生很難買到合適的洋裝，就決定只設計給這些女生穿。剛開始，每個月只賣出幾件，家人都要她別再做了。她說：「就算現在賣得不多，我也想再試一年。再說，我還年輕，吃點苦沒關係。」後來，一位有名的演員穿了她設計的洋裝去參加婚禮，照片在網路上被很多人看到以後，她的生意一下子就好了起來。現在，她的店可以說是個子不高的女生最喜歡的服裝店。
text.simplified: 我的朋友小美从小就喜欢画衣服，她的梦想是有一家自己的服装店。大学毕业以后，她没有去公司上班，而是在网路上卖自己设计的衣服。她发现个子不高的女生很难买到合适的洋装，就决定只设计给这些女生穿。刚开始，每个月只卖出几件，家人都要她别再做了。她说：「就算现在卖得不多，我也想再试一年。再说，我还年轻，吃点苦没关系。」后来，一位有名的演员穿了她设计的洋装去参加婚礼，照片在网路上被很多人看到以后，她的生意一下子就好了起来。现在，她的店可以说是个子不高的女生最喜欢的服装店。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu Xiǎoměi cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuān huà yīfu, tā de mèngxiǎng shì yǒu yì jiā zìjǐ de fúzhuāng diàn. Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā méiyǒu qù gōngsī shàngbān, ér shì zài wǎnglù shàng mài zìjǐ shèjì de yīfu. Tā fāxiàn gèzi bù gāo de nǚshēng hěn nán mǎidào héshì de yángzhuāng, jiù juédìng zhǐ shèjì gěi zhèxiē nǚshēng chuān. Gāng kāishǐ, měi ge yuè zhǐ mài chū jǐ jiàn, jiārén dōu yào tā bié zài zuò le. Tā shuō: "Jiùsuàn xiànzài mài de bù duō, wǒ yě xiǎng zài shì yì nián. Zàishuō, wǒ hái niánqīng, chī diǎn kǔ méi guānxi." Hòulái, yí wèi yǒumíng de yǎnyuán chuān le tā shèjì de yángzhuāng qù cānjiā hūnlǐ, zhàopiàn zài wǎnglù shàng bèi hěn duō rén kàndào yǐhòu, tā de shēngyì yíxiàzi jiù hǎo le qǐlái. Xiànzài, tā de diàn kěyǐ shuō shì gèzi bù gāo de nǚshēng zuì xǐhuān de fúzhuāng diàn.
text.english: My friend Xiaomei has loved drawing clothes since she was little, and her dream was to have a clothes shop of her own. After university she did not go to work for a company; she sold clothes she designed online. She found that short women find it hard to buy dresses that fit, so she decided to design only for them. At first she sold only a few pieces a month, and her family all wanted her to stop. She said: "Even if I am not selling much now, I want to try for one more year. Besides, I am young, and a little hardship is fine." Later a well-known actress wore a dress she had designed to a wedding, and once many people saw the photos online her business suddenly took off. Now her shop could be called the favourite clothes shop of women who are not tall.
